name: cockpit
description: Above-prompt dashboard for prompt cache, quota resets, Codex quota, pipeline executors, and pull requests. Windows notifications and a tab indicator for permissions, questions, and completion. Guards codex-run and claude-run launches.

ttl.title: Prompt cache TTL
ttl.description: Auto starts at 1 hour and changes to 5 minutes when a quota window reaches 100% or a model change signals it.

warnMinutes.title: Cache warning lead time (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: How many minutes before the cache expires to warn. Set to 0 to disable.

bigContextK.title: Large context threshold (thousands of tokens)
bigContextK.description: Above this threshold, when the cache has expired, the dashboard suggests starting a new chat or using /compact.

codexQuotaMinutes.title: Codex quota refresh interval (minutes)
codexQuotaMinutes.description: How often to read Codex quota with Codeburn. Set to 0 to disable.

launchGuard.title: Launcher guard
launchGuard.description: Blocks codex-run without -FullAccess, resumes without -FixLoop, launches without -TimeoutMinutes, and a second executor in the same worktree. codex-run -ReadOnly can omit -FullAccess and -FixLoop, runs even when the worktree is busy, and leaves it available to other executors. Moves foreground launches to the background.

minMinutes.title: Minimum turn time for completion notification (minutes)
minMinutes.description: Shows a completion notification for turns at least this long. The tab indicator also appears for shorter turns.

windowsNotification.title: Windows notifications
windowsNotification.description: Windows notifications for permissions, questions, plans, turns ending, and executors finishing.

tabBadge.title: Tab indicator
tabBadge.description: Colors the Windows Terminal tab and taskbar button yellow when Claude is waiting for you, green when work finishes, and red for an error.
